run_preprocess_ego_narrations: run preprocess_ego_narrations to encode Ego4D narrations with a language model and save embeddings to disk
run_preprocess_ego_features: run preprocess_ego_features to save video features from a directory into an HDF5 file
run_get_narrations: run get_narrations to load and extract narration text and timestamps from an Ego4D narration JSON file
run_filter_narrations: run filter_narrations to remove val/test set narrations and short texts below a minimum word count
run_remove_tags: run remove_tags to strip camera wearer, other person, and unsure tags from narration text
